sections.title: Items
sections.note: Upgrades are tiers: the Phantom Sword, and the Bomb Bag, Quiver and Bombchu Bag by capacity.

items.name: Sword
items.notes: The Spirit of Power's upgrades raise its damage and the Spirit of Courage's give it beams.

tiers.name: Oshus's Sword
tiers.howTo: In Oshus's storehouse on Mercay Island (the password is the number of palm trees on the beach).

tiers.name: Phantom Sword
tiers.howTo: Zauz forges it from the three Pure Metals and Oshus completes it with the Phantom Hourglass.

items.name: Wooden Shield
items.howTo: Buy it for 80 Rupees at the Mercay Island Shop (also at the Molida and Goron Island shops).
items.notes: A Like Like can eat it; buy another. The Spirit of Wisdom's upgrades strengthen it.

items.name: Boomerang
items.howTo: The dungeon item of the Temple of Fire, in its big chest on 2F.

items.name: Bombs
items.notes: The Bomb Bag isn't shown on the Collection Screen until the first upgrade.

tiers.name: Bombs (bag of 10)
tiers.howTo: The dungeon item of the Temple of Wind.

tiers.name: Bomb Bag (20)
tiers.howTo: Buy it from Beedle's Shop Ship for 1,000 Rupees once you carry Bombs.

tiers.name: Bomb Bag (30)
tiers.howTo: Score 2,500 points or more at Salvatore's Cannon Game on Bannan Island.

items.name: Bow
items.notes: Zelda Wiki gives each source a fixed capacity: 30 from the Shooting Range and 50 from the shop.

tiers.name: Bow (quiver of 20)
tiers.howTo: The dungeon item of the Temple of Courage.

tiers.name: Quiver (30)
tiers.howTo: Score 1,700–1,999 points at Romanos's Shooting Range on Molida Island (open after the Temple of Courage).

tiers.name: Quiver (50)
tiers.howTo: Buy it for 1,000 Rupees at the Molida Island Shop or Mercay Island Shop after the Temple of Courage.

items.name: Bombchus
items.notes: Each bag adds 10. The Goron Game opens once Gongoron writes to you after the Temple of Ice.

tiers.name: Bombchus (bag of 10)
tiers.howTo: The dungeon item of the Goron Temple.

tiers.name: Bombchu Bag (20)
tiers.howTo: Buy it for 1,000 Rupees at the Goron Island Shop, or beat the Goron Game record (35 seconds) on Dee Ess Island.

tiers.name: Bombchu Bag (30)
tiers.howTo: Whichever of the two you haven't done: the Goron Island Shop or the Goron Game record.

items.name: Grappling Hook
items.howTo: The dungeon item of the Temple of Ice.

items.name: Hammer
items.howTo: The dungeon item of Mutoh's Temple.

items.name: Shovel
items.howTo: In a chest in the Old Wayfarer's first hideaway, the cave on Molida Island.

sections.title: Key Items
sections.note: Quest items and the ship's tools. Sea Charts and Pure Metals are in the Main Quest.

items.name: Phantom Hourglass
items.howTo: Oshus has you take it from the altar in the temple's Entry Hall on your second visit.
items.notes: Its sand protects you from the temple's curse; sunlight refills it. Its minutes are on the Phantom Hourglass tab.

items.name: Cannon
items.howTo: Buy it from Eddo for 50 Rupees after crossing Cannon Island.
items.notes: Eddo's Cannon is also the SS Linebeck set's cannon part.

items.name: Salvage Arm
items.howTo: Buy it from Eddo once his letter says it's ready, after the Temple of the Ocean King's B6; 200 to 1,000 Rupees depending on how loud you yell.
items.notes: Gazpacho at the Mercay Shipyard repairs it.

items.name: Sun Key
items.howTo: Salvage it at the Courage Crest marked on the Southwestern Sea Chart.

items.name: Cyclone Slate
items.howTo: Hit the island's four Gossip Stones in the order of the whale riddle (rudder, spray, paddle, eye) and meet Golden Chief Cylos in the cave.
items.notes: Optional. Draw a Golden Frog's symbol on it to warp; the frogs are in Sea Chart & Islands.

items.name: Ghost Key
items.howTo: Dropped by the Cubus Sisters; it opens the locked block in front of Tetra.

items.name: Regal Necklace
items.howTo: In King Brant's tomb on the Isle of the Dead.

items.name: King's Key
items.howTo: Doylan's spirit gives it to you in his pyramid on the Isle of Ruins.

items.name: Fishing Rod
items.howTo: Find the 'mermaid' Joanne around Bannan Island (hit her with the Boomerang), then visit the Old Wayfarer once she's moved in.

sections.title: Phantom Hourglass
sections.note: 10 minutes when you get it, 2 more from each later boss but the Cubus Sisters, and 1 from each of five Sunken Treasures: 25 at most.

items.name: Sand of Hours (Treasure Map #4)

items.name: Sand of Hours (Treasure Map #23)
